description: This source file manages temporary files, including creation, cleanup, and cleanup handlers for program exit and signals. It maintains a linked list of tempfile structures, ensures proper cleanup of temporary files upon process exit or signal, and provides functions for handling tempfile lifecycles.

classes.name: struct tempfile
classes.description: Represents a temporary file, including its filename, file descriptor, FILE pointer, owner PID, associated directory, and list linkage.

methods.name: int remove_template_directory(struct tempfile * tempfile,int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with a tempfile, with special handling if called from a signal handler.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles(int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Iterates over the global tempfile list and removes files owned by the current process, handling files open or closed.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_exit(void)
methods.description: Cleanup function registered for program exit.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_signal(int signo)
methods.description: Cleanup function registered for signals, re-raises the signal after cleanup.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * new_tempfile(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new tempfile structure.

methods.name: void activate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Adds the tempfile to the global list and records ownership PID, also sets up cleanup handlers on first call.

methods.name: void deactivate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Removes the tempfile from the global list and frees associated resources.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * create_tempfile_mode(const char * path,int mode)
methods.description: Creates and opens a new temporary file at a specified path with given mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * register_tempfile(const char * path)
methods.description: Registers an existing file as a tempfile.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_sm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a given filename template and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_tsm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in TMPDIR (or /tmp) with a filename template and mode.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_dt(const char * directory_template,const char * filename)
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and a file within it, returns the tempfile structure.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * xmks_tempfile_m(const char * filename_template,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a filename template and mode, aborts on failure.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile,const char * mode)
methods.description: Associates a FILE pointer with the tempfile's file descriptor.

methods.name: const char * get_tempfile_path(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the filename of the tempfile.

methods.name: int get_tempfile_fd(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_tempfile_fp(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer associated with the tempfile.

methods.name: int close_tempfile_gently(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the tempfile and its associated resources.

methods.name: int reopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Reopens a tempfile that has been closed, returning its file descriptor.

methods.name: int rename_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p,const char * path)
methods.description: Renames a tempfile's file to a new path, deactivating it afterward.

methods.name: int delete_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p)
methods.description: Deletes a tempfile, closing, removing file, and freeing resources.

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_sm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_sm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_tsm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/
